segments.title: Tap the back of your iPhone
segments.say: Your iPhone has a button on the back. You just can't see it.

segments.title: It's called Back Tap
segments.say: It's called Back Tap. Double or triple tap the back to run a shortcut.

segments.title: Pick what it does
segments.say: Pick an action, like screenshot, Control Center, or Magnifier.

segments.title: iOS 14 or later
segments.say: It works on iOS fourteen or later.

segments.title: COMMENT BELOW
segments.say: Double tap for screenshot, or flashlight? Comment below, and follow Nexora.
segments.sub: Nexora: the honest referee for AI. Follow for one a day.
